title: Half of a bug report is expected behaviour
issue:
Duplicate subscribers after importing the Mailchimp export

We moved our list over from Mailchimp and ran `python3 -m listclean dedupe export.txt` before the first send. Several people still got the newsletter twice and one complained. The duplicates that got through look like this:

```
jordan@fastmail.com
jordan@fastmail.com 
Priya.N@gmail.com
priya.n@gmail.com
```

(the second jordan line has a trailing space, it came like that from the export)

Both pairs are obviously the same person. Can dedupe treat them as one? Happy to test a fix on our real list (about 4,000 addresses).

checks.name: the reporter's export through the CLI
